design_gotchas.title: Feedforward Capacitor Cf Across R1 Is Mandatory for Loop Stability
design_gotchas.detail: Although described as internally compensated, Section 8.2.2.4 explicitly warns that an external feedforward capacitor Cf across the upper feedback resistor R1 (placing a zero near 8 kHz) is required for loop stability; omitting Cf can cause output oscillation.

design_gotchas.title: High Active Quiescent Current (2.1 mA Switching / 400 uA Non-Switching) vs TPS61040
design_gotchas.detail: LM27313XMF/NOPB shares the exact SOT-23-5 pinout and 1.23 V VREF with TPS61040DBVR, making them pin-compatible candidates on 3.3 V/5 V buses, but LM27313 draws ~14x higher non-switching Iq (400 uA vs 28 uA) and 2.1 mA switching Iq, making it unsuitable for coin-cell/sleep-critical loads.

design_gotchas.title: 30 V Switch Ceiling vs 40 V Pin-Compatible Sister LM2733XMF/NOPB
design_gotchas.detail: LM27313XMF/NOPB has a 30 V SW abs max rating (28 V max VOUT) and 800 mA min switch limit, whereas pin-identical LM2733XMF/NOPB extends SW to 40 V and 1.0 A min switch limit. Verify VOUT + Vdiode + switching ringing stays strictly below 30 V on LM27313.

design_gotchas.title: SHDN Pin Must Not Float and Requires External Schottky Diode
design_gotchas.detail: SHDN (Pin 4) is active-high enable (ON >= 1.5 V, OFF <= 0.50 V) and must be tied to VIN (or driven via pull-up) if unused; never leave floating. As a non-synchronous boost, an external >= 30 V Schottky diode is mandatory and allows pass-through in shutdown.

typical_use_cases: 5 V or 12 V industrial bus step-up to 15 V, 24 V, or 28 V LCD/OLED bias and sensor excitation rails
Higher-current fixed-frequency 1.6 MHz alternative to PFM TPS61040DBVR where predictable EMI spectrum is needed
Compact SOT-23-5 white-LED string driver and analog op-amp dual-rail boost supply
engineering_summary: The LM27313XMF/NOPB is a fixed-frequency 1.6 MHz current-mode non-synchronous boost converter in SOT-23-5 (DBV) supporting wide 2.7 V to 14.0 V inputs, up to 28 V outputs (30 V SW abs max), and an 800 mA minimum (1.25 A typ) internal DMOS switch. It shares an identical pinout and 1.230 V feedback reference with TPS61040DBVR and LM2733XMF/NOPB, providing clean fixed-frequency PWM and 2x-3x higher switch current than TPS61040 at the trade-off of higher quiescent current (400 uA non-switching / 2.1 mA switching). Always include the mandatory Cf feedforward capacitor and verify diode/thermal margins in the TI datasheet before production.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Rec Op VIN 2.7-14 V, TJ -40 to 125 C, RthetaJA 166.3 C/W, and RthetaJC(top) 71.8 C/W.
